source: Messier catalogue, public domain astronomical data

objects.name: Crab Nebula
objects.description: Expanding remnant of a supernova recorded by Chinese astronomers in 1054.

objects.name: Lagoon Nebula
objects.description: Giant interstellar cloud with an embedded young open cluster.

objects.name: Great Globular Cluster in Hercules
objects.description: Several hundred thousand stars packed into a sphere 145 light-years across.

objects.name: Eagle Nebula
objects.description: Home of the Pillars of Creation, a region of active star formation.

objects.name: Omega Nebula
objects.description: One of the brightest and most massive star-forming regions in the galaxy.

objects.name: Trifid Nebula
objects.description: Rare combination of an open cluster, emission, reflection and dark nebula.

objects.name: Dumbbell Nebula
objects.description: The first planetary nebula ever discovered.

objects.name: Andromeda Galaxy
objects.description: Nearest large spiral galaxy, on a collision course with the Milky Way.

objects.name: Triangulum Galaxy
objects.description: Third-largest member of the Local Group of galaxies.

objects.name: Orion Nebula
objects.description: The closest region of massive star formation to Earth.

objects.name: Beehive Cluster
objects.description: One of the nearest open clusters, known since antiquity.

objects.name: Pleiades
objects.description: Hot blue B-type stars wrapped in reflection nebulosity.

objects.name: Whirlpool Galaxy
objects.description: The first galaxy in which spiral structure was recognised.

objects.name: Ring Nebula
objects.description: A dying sun-like star shedding its outer envelope.

objects.name: Sunflower Galaxy
objects.description: Flocculent spiral with many discontinuous, patchy arms.

objects.name: Black Eye Galaxy
objects.description: A spectacular dark dust band in front of the bright nucleus.

objects.name: Casper the Friendly Ghost Nebula
objects.description: The brightest diffuse reflection nebula in the sky.

objects.name: Bode's Galaxy
objects.description: Grand design spiral with an active galactic nucleus.

objects.name: Cigar Galaxy
objects.description: Starburst galaxy forming stars ten times faster than the Milky Way.

objects.name: Virgo A
objects.description: Its supermassive black hole was the first ever directly imaged.

objects.name: Globular Cluster in Hercules
objects.description: One of the oldest known clusters, roughly as old as the universe.

objects.name: Owl Nebula
objects.description: Two dark patches give this shell the appearance of an owl's eyes.

objects.name: Pinwheel Galaxy
objects.description: Face-on spiral with unusually asymmetric, high-contrast arms.

objects.name: Sombrero Galaxy
objects.description: Bright bulge crossed by a sharply defined dust lane.

objects.name: Spiral Galaxy in Canes Venatici
objects.description: Anomalous arms of hot gas driven by the central black hole.

objects.name: Satellite of Andromeda
objects.description: Dwarf elliptical companion to the Andromeda Galaxy.
